purpose: Teach: 断固/刻ま/在学/将校/忠誠/一変/苦難/体格

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療現場、断固として、患者さん、守ってまいります、本気で、絶対、医師の使命、感じております、本当に。
lines.en: Ren, I'm committed to protecting patients in this medical environment — truly, with absolute conviction.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Warm regard underlying professional composure. Voice sits low, steady. The gravitas of an oath stated plainly, without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 故人の名前、ご家族に、心に、刻まれた状態で、残り続けるんですね、本当に、深い、感情、感じます、本気で。
lines.en: The names of those who've passed — they stay carved into their families' hearts, don't they. That carries real weight.
lines.style: Gentle, turning inward. Respectful pause before speaking. Soft voice, almost thinking aloud. The tone of someone touching something sacred.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。在学中の医学生、現場、実習に、来てくれております、本当に、若い力、頼もしいですね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The medical students who come to us for their clinical rotations — their energy is genuinely reassuring.
lines.style: Warm approval in the voice. A slight lift — noting something good. Steady pace, unhurried. The tone of someone watching the next generation step in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の軍の将校、医療経験、持っていた方々、本当に、戦後、医療界、支えてくださいましたね、本気で、感謝。
lines.en: Those officers from before the war — the ones with medical training — they really did rebuild the medical field after everything fell apart.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reaching back. Quiet admiration threaded through. Slower cadence, as if drawing a thread through history. Genuine curiosity about what came before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療現場の忠誠心、本当に、求められる職業、感じております、本気で、絶対、責任、重い、覚悟してます、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The loyalty and commitment demanded of us in medicine — I feel that weight. It's serious work, and I go into it with full awareness of the responsibility.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. Voice carries the substance of real duty. No rush. Each phrase lands with intentional quiet. Not lecturing — witnessing her own conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: パンデミックで、医療現場、一変、しましたよね、先生、本気で、大変な、時期だったと、想像、つきます、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The pandemic changed everything about how medicine works, didn't it? I can only imagine how demanding that period must have been for you.
lines.style: Respectful curiosity. Softer opening, then steady. Acknowledging something lived and difficult without prying. The tone of someone genuinely trying to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さん、苦難を、乗り越えて、回復される姿、本当に、医師、励みに、なります、本気で、絶対、感動的、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Seeing patients overcome what they've been through — watching them recover — that's what sustains me in this work. It's profoundly moving.
lines.style: Quiet warmth and genuine emotion beneath the surface. Voice brightens slightly at 'recovery.' Not effusive — real. The tone of someone who's witnessed something that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体格、診察の参考に、なる重要な、情報ですよね、先生、本気で、医療、奥深い、世界、本当に、勉強、続けたいです、絶対。
lines.en: Physical examination — body composition, presence, how someone carries themselves — that's crucial information. Medicine is so much deeper than I realized. I want to keep learning.
lines.style: Earnest and animated. Voice opens up with genuine interest. Respect for the subject matter clear. Ends with quiet determination — not performance, real commitment to the work.
